g.text: Chicago, Boston, Miami and Denver · Fixed-Radius Best Fit

g.text: Best fit, not a circle through all four cities. Chicago is 272 miles inside; Boston is 327 miles outside.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6570

g.text: The 2,100-mile span is the lesson’s rounded estimate (the Moon is about 2,160 miles wide), not a literal lunar footprint.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6570

g.text: Circle radius: 1,050 statute miles. Center minimizes squared WGS84 radial errors across all four unchanged city points.

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6570

g.text: Azimuthal Equidistant · Center 31.0393°N, 91.6444°W · Distances from center are exact; scale elsewhere varies.
